_readme: Manual sale prices that survive the daily price run (scripts/check_prices.py). Format: {"<vendor>": {"<exact item key from data/product_urls.json>": {"price": 80, "regular_price": 100, "expires": "2026-10-05T04:59:00Z", "source": "vendor email 2026-09-28, code FALL20"}}}. Only listed sizes get the sale price; entries are skipped once 'expires' (UTC) has passed. Jackson confirms every entry from the vendor's email before it is added.
